user.title: Select zone
user.description: Choose the city (operating zone) for this stop.

stop.title: Add bus stop
stop.description: Enter the stop code painted on the stop sign, e.g. P45068.

filters.title: Departure options
filters.description: Optional filters and polling. Use commas for lists; tracked routes as ROUTE or ROUTE:I|R.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Red Regional
reauth_confirm.description: The backend rejected recent requests. Confirm to retry this stop.

reconfigure.title: Change Red Regional stop
reconfigure.description: Pick a new zone or stop code for this entry.

error.invalid_stop: Invalid stop code for this zone.

init.title: Red Regional options
init.description: Filters, live tracking, and polling for this stop.

refresh.name: Refresh departures
refresh.description: Force an immediate poll of a stop entry.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device of the entry to refresh.

lookup_stop.name: Look up a stop
lookup_stop.description: Search cached stops by code or name fragment.

get_vehicles.name: Get live vehicles
get_vehicles.description: Return live GPS telemetry for one route and direction.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: I for outbound, R for return.

confirm.title: Fix unknown stop
confirm.description: Stop {stop_code} is no longer reported by the backend. Reconfigure the entry with a valid stop code.

confirm.title: Retry the backend
confirm.description: Stop {stop_code} has not answered several polls in a row. Confirm to reload the entry and retry.
